picks.headline: Over 500 Free Maya Animation Tools Are Now Available In One Place
picks.excerpt: Animo v10.0 collects more than 500 free Maya animation tools into a single library, putting a large chunk of the animator's daily toolkit behind one install.
picks.rationale: Highest-actionability item in the pool — one install changes an animator's Maya toolkit tomorrow morning, and it is fresh (Sept 4).

picks.headline: Tamar AI's TapNow Brings AI-Native Filmmaking to Venice Production Bridge, Unveils Streamer Glanze
picks.excerpt: TapNow, HappyHorse and Glanze head to the Venice Production Bridge as Palo Alto's Tamar AI bets its AI-native 'creative operating system' can turn small teams into global studios. The web version of streamer Glanze launched Sept. 4 with 40-plus series.
picks.rationale: A new AI-native production stack plus a live streaming outlet shipping the same day — the distribution half of AI filmmaking that most tool news skips.

picks.headline: One of the new categories at the VES Awards is 'Outstanding In-Camera Effects in a Photoreal Project'
picks.excerpt: The Visual Effects Society announced new categories and rule updates for the VES Awards, including a category that singles out effects achieved in camera rather than generated in post.
picks.rationale: A rule change, not a rehash: the industry's own awards body is now formally rewarding what is achieved in camera — a direct read on where the generative-vs-practical line is being drawn.

picks.headline: Introducing Solaris, our first Interface World Model
picks.excerpt: Runway unveils Solaris, an 'interface world model' that generates interactive interfaces frame by frame — a generative system aimed at software surfaces rather than shots.
picks.rationale: New model class from a first-party source: a world model pointed at interfaces rather than shots, which widens what a generative pipeline can be asked to produce.

picks.headline: What makes a good ROTOSCOPE?
picks.excerpt: Emmy-nominated VFX supervisor Marion Spates breaks down what separates a good roto from a bad one — the craft judgement that automated matting tools still have to clear.
picks.rationale: Concrete craft criteria from a working VFX supervisor — the quality bar any auto-matting or AI roto tool has to clear before it ships in a shot.
